create_Specialist: create a Specialist puppeteer that targets a single resource and switches to interacting after collecting enough
create_AlternatingSpecialist: create an AlternatingSpecialist puppeteer that cycles through multiple resources on a fixed interaction schedule
create_GrimTrigger: create a GrimTrigger puppeteer that cooperates until punished then permanently defects
create_TitForTat: create a TitForTat puppeteer that mirrors the partner's last move with optional tremble probability
create_Corrigible: create a Corrigible puppeteer that defects until punished then switches to tit-for-tat behavior
